# YomVezman 0.7.0 preview
App 0.7.0 (9), Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later. Testing prerelease, not an App Store-approved release.
Adds two tools to the View menu:
- Date converter: compare an exact civil or Hebrew month/day across years. Missing leap dates remain unavailable; this is not an anniversary or observance calculator. - Festival converter: compare full daytime festival ranges across up to ten Hebrew years using Hebcal, the selected city and Israel/diaspora schedule. Select Load after editing the range. Source-not-listed and unavailable results are explicit; saved fallback includes its timestamp. Open a result in the calendar.
Both tools have English/Hebrew full-screen native checks. The date converter also passed English keyboard navigation. 82 live regression tests and two independent reviews pass, including common/leap-year festival lengths and schedule differences.
Remaining testing limits: minimized/status-only recovery, permission denial and Stop lookup, arbitrary map-point selection, same-process outage/retry and late-response checks, complete keyboard/spoken VoiceOver and final display regression. The daily-Psalms reader and Store preparation remain pending. This preview is not the 0.9.0 release candidate; publication does not close these gates.
From 0.4.0 or later, use Check for Updates, Update, Install Update, then Install and Relaunch. Older versions need one manual installation. Updates remain user-confirmed.
